The '''Battle of Gal Milnor''' was fought both on and above [[Gal Milnor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The destruction of a convoy of freighters and an Alliance storage facility greatly dampened the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet's]] effectiveness in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for a considerable amount of time, until [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Yamarus/Legends|Yamarus]] made a pact with the smuggler coalition headed by [[Dunari]].
